newsitem.title: ITALY: Deroma sales up, U.S. pottery buy near.
newsitem.headline: Deroma sales up, U.S. pottery buy near.

text.p: Italian terracotta pot maker Deroma, posting sales in the first four months of 1997 up 12 percent at 63.2 billion lire, is near to concluding the acquisition of Marshall Pottery of the United States.

"The deal is almost finalised, it's a question of a few weeks," Deroma Managing Director Franco Masello told reporters after the company's first shareholders' meeting since its bourse listing in March. He gave no further details.
The Vicenza-based group posted 1996 consolidated net profit of 13.3 billion lire, up 18.7 percent on 1995, on sales of 114.3 billion lire, up 7.7 percent.
